package.name: x-search
package.packageFile:
$schema: ../_schema/package.schema.json

# FULLY DECLARATIVE. One node, one endpoint, one bearer token, nothing new required.
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/x-search/`.

name: x-search
displayName: X Search
description: Search recent X (Twitter) posts
version: 2.0.0
category: search
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1777865512/gravity/icons/X_logo.jpg

features:
  - Recent post search with X query operators
  - Per-post engagement metrics

allowedHosts:
  - api.x.com

requires:
  credential: [bearer]
  transport: [json]
  executorVersion: ">=1.0.0"

credentials.xCredential.yaml:
$schema: ../../_schema/credential.schema.json

name: xCredential
displayName: X (Twitter)
description: Credentials for X API v2
documentationUrl: https://developer.x.com/en/docs/authentication/oauth-2-0/application-only

properties:
  - name: bearerToken
    displayName: Bearer Token
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: X API v2 Bearer Token, app-only auth
    placeholder: ""

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output connector, in interface.yaml order.
#
# A query that matched nothing returns no `data` key at all, which is a valid empty result
# rather than an error, so every row tolerates its absence.

- emit: tweets
  from: response
  value: "return response.data || []"

- emit: resultCount
  from: response
  value: "return (response.data || []).length"

- emit: raw
  from: response
  value: "return JSON.stringify(response)"
files.api/run.yaml:
# One call. The upstream `query` input wins over the configured one, which is what the
# retired executor did and what the input's description promises.

- name: search
  method: GET
  url: https://api.x.com/2/tweets/search/recent
  credential:
    scheme: bearer
    token: "{{ credentials.xCredential.bearerToken }}"
  query:
    query: >-
      return typeof signal.query === 'string' && signal.query.trim()
        ? signal.query.trim()
        : config.query
    # Clamped to the vendor's 1..100 rather than trusted: a saved workflow can hold
    # anything, and X rejects the request rather than clamping it for you.
    max_results: "return String(Math.min(Math.max(config.maxResults || 10, 1), 100))"
    tweet.fields: "return config.tweetFields || 'created_at,public_metrics,author_id'"
  transport: json
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
  # X reports a bad operator or an exhausted quota in the body with a 200 in some cases.
  error:
    when: "return !!response.errors && !response.data"
    message: "return response.errors.map(e => e.detail || e.title || e.message).join('; ')"
files.config.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/config.schema.json

configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [query]
  properties:
    query:
      type: string
      title: Search Query
      description: >-
        X search query. Supports from:user, #hashtag, -exclude, lang:en and OR without
        parentheses. Wrap phrases in quotes, e.g. "Miro board" lang:en -is:retweet
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    maxResults:
      type: number
      title: Max Results
      description: Number of posts to return
      default: 10
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 100
    tweetFields:
      type: string
      title: Tweet Fields
      description: Comma-separated X API tweet fields to include
      default: created_at,public_metrics,author_id
"ui:order": [query, maxResults, tweetFields]
files.interface.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/interface.schema.json

inputs:
  - name: query
    type: string
    description: Search query. Overrides the configured one when present.
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: tweets
    type: array
    description: The posts, as the X API returned them
  - name: resultCount
    type: number
    description: How many posts came back
  - name: raw
    type: string
    description: The whole X API response as JSON, for anything the shaped outputs drop

credentials:
  - name: xCredential
    required: true
    displayName: X API Credentials
files.node.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/node.schema.json

type: XSearch
kind: PromiseNode
name: X Search
category: Search
color: "#000000"
description: Search recent X (Twitter) posts and return structured tweet data
whenToUse: >
  Search recent X (Twitter) posts by keyword, hashtag, user or language and get structured
  tweet data with engagement metrics; supports X query operators (from:, #hashtag, lang:,
  -is:retweet). It returns native posts with per-post engagement metrics, not crawled web
  pages and not scraped arbitrary sites.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (DECLARATIVE_NODES.md §9.13). Compulsory on every node, so that a node
# nobody thought about cannot look the same as one deliberately left open.
#
# `required: false` adds no requirement of its own: the node runs for whoever the trigger
# admitted. The trigger instance's publicEntry toggle still owns the door, and requirements
# only ever narrow.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # Recent-search results move as people post, but the same query within a run is the same
  # answer and the call has no side effect.
  cacheable: true
files.test.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/test.schema.json

testData:
  config:
    query: AI agents lang:en -is:retweet
    maxResults: 10
    tweetFields: created_at,public_metrics,author_id
  inputs:
    query: AI agents lang:en -is:retweet
  expect:
    tweets: "return output.tweets.length > 0 && typeof output.tweets[0].text === 'string'"
    resultCount: "return output.resultCount === output.tweets.length"
    raw: "return JSON.parse(output.raw).data.length === output.resultCount"
